@graph.headline: Infinity Ink - Infinity

@graph.description: 'Inigo Montoya - .E.S' is a hypnotic fusion of electronic beats and introspective melodies, creating a dreamlike atmosphere that invites listeners into a reflective journey. The track's mysterious soundscape makes it both haunting and deeply engaging.
@graph.headline: Inigo Montoya - .E.S

@graph.description: Ivy Levan's smoky, swaggering vocal slinks over a sleek, bass-heavy pop beat, with a rap verse from Cadre: a track from her 2015 'swamp-hop' debut that fits its title, tight, dark and made to measure.
@graph.headline: Ivy Levan, Cadre - Like A Glove

@graph.description: The closing song of Jain's 2015 Hope EP, produced by Yodelice: her bright, slightly mischievous voice riding a homemade-sounding beat that mixes pop simplicity with the rhythmic colours of a childhood spent between Dubai, Congo and Abu Dhabi.
@graph.headline: Jain - City

citation.name: Music You Should Know: Jain's Irresistible "Come" Balances Dark Poetry with a Light Bounce

@graph.description: Jain's debut hit hides a lovesick lyric under a happy bounce: chugging guitar, bashful horns and double-tracked vocals, under three minutes of Afro-pop lightness that went to number one in France.
@graph.headline: Jain - Come

@graph.description: Jain's light, sing-song voice, her own drum programming and Yodelice's bass and trombone carry a small, sunny plea for a better world, the title track of her first EP in 2015.
@graph.headline: Jain - Hope

@graph.description: “Makeba” by Jain is an upbeat, irresistibly catchy tribute to the South African singer and activist Miriam Makeba, built on a Hamilton Bohannon sample, a call-and-response refrain and bright, home-programmed pop.
@graph.headline: Jain - Makeba

@graph.description: Handclap-light percussion, a bouncing bass and Jain's playful, slightly mischievous delivery make Mr Johnson one of Zanaka's sunniest little stories.
@graph.headline: Jain - Mr Johnson

citation.name: Album Review: Jain Confirms We Can All Be A "Souldier"
Jain - On My Way (Official Lyric Video)

@graph.description: The opening track of Jain's second album Souldier (2018): a three-minute song of encouragement to move on from hard times, written by Jain, produced with Yodelice and played on an Arabic drum rather than a tabla.
@graph.headline: Jain - On My Way

@graph.description: Zanaka's gentle closer, a reggae-tinged sway where Jain lets the album's travels settle into calm, sunlit contentment.
@graph.headline: Jain - So Peaceful

@graph.description: One of the six songs and versions Jain added to Zanaka in November 2016, also released on their own as the Zanaka EP: written by Jain, arranged, produced and mixed by Yodelice, with Jain on keyboards and Yodelice on guitar and bass.
@graph.headline: Jain - Son of a Sun

citation.name: The Hanging Tree (The Hunger Games song)

@graph.description: Jennifer Lawrence's eerie Mockingjay folk song recast as an uptempo, drum-heavy rebel anthem, the unaccompanied verse growing into a pounding march with strings and a dance pulse.
@graph.headline: James Newton Howard, Jennifer Lawrence - The Hanging Tree (Rebel Remix)

citation.name: The Hanging Tree (The Hunger Games song)

@graph.description: Jennifer Lawrence's bare, unpolished voice sings an eerie murder ballad from Suzanne Collins' Mockingjay, set to a melody by the Lumineers, that swells into a rebel anthem as James Newton Howard's orchestra gathers behind her.
@graph.headline: James Newton Howard, Jennifer Lawrence - The Hanging Tree

@graph.description: The Zürich duo Animal Trainer fold Jan Blomqvist's hushed 2011 cover of Big Jet Plane into a rolling, late-night deep house remix, released on the Berlin label Dantze, where a longing vocal drifts above a patient, pulsing groove.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist, Animal Trainer - Big Jet Plane (Animal Trainer Remix)

@graph.description: Jan Blomqvist slows Angus & Julia Stone's folk lullaby into a long, glowing melodic-house drift, his weary vocal hovering over the pulse like a plane above night clouds.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist - Big Jet Plane

citation.name: Jan Blomqvist sparks global tour with release of debut album
Jan Blomqvist - Dark Noise (Remote Control Tour Recap)

@graph.description: One of the long tracks of Jan Blomqvist's 2016 debut album Remote Control: eight and a half minutes from the Berlin singer and live electronic bandleader, written with his lyricist Ryan Mathiesen.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist - Dark Noise

citation.name: Jan Blomqvist - Something Says (Live at WEEKEND Rooftop)

@graph.description: The track from Jan Blomqvist's first EP for Oliver Koletzki's Stil vor Talent, Ink of 2012, that made him known: a stripped-down dance track that builds patiently towards a climax of washed-out piano and whispers, and a rooftop video from Berlin that he calls the moment it all began.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist - Something Says

citation.name: Exploring Berlin places with Jan Blomqvist

@graph.description: Jan Blomqvist's 2014 summer hit sets his soft, echoing voice, Felix Lehmann's Rhodes piano and two guitars over a minimal deep house pulse, the sound of the Berlin 'concert techno' he helped bring to big stages.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist - Time Again

citation.name: JANIS: Hypnotized - Dancers lose control in this electro-pop music video

@graph.description: Hypnotized, the 2015 single with which the French singer once known as Sliimy returned as a Paris electro-pop producer, in its 4:08 audio version; its video, directed by Ludovic Zuili, filmed dancers under the influence of hypnosis.
@graph.headline: JANIS - Hypnotized

citation.name: Songs You Should Know: Jeanne Added — 'A War Is Coming'
Jeanne Added - A war is coming (video)
Jeanne Added, Agora des Arts, Rouyn-Noranda QC, September 5

@graph.description: The first single from Jeanne Added's debut album Be Sensational: two and a half minutes of militaristic mood, a simple melody over a stuttered march rhythm and her own voice multiplied into choirs that warn of a coming war.
@graph.headline: Jeanne Added - A War Is Coming

citation.name: Joachim Pastor: I just do the music I like and I don't care about codes and trends
INTERVIEW: Five Minutes With … Joachim Pastor
Simple As F**k - S02E05 - Eternity (Joachim Pastor)

@graph.description: Eternity is Joachim Pastor's 2016 single for Hungry Music, the Aix-en-Provence label he founded with Worakls and N'to: six minutes of melodic techno from a conservatory-trained producer who calls himself an analog gear geek.
@graph.headline: Joachim Pastor - Eternity

@graph.description: Kove drives John Newman's northern-soul plea for a second chance into rolling drum and bass, the raw voice riding fast breaks and big, bright chords.
@graph.headline: John Newman, Kove - Love Me Again (Kove Remix)

inAlbum.name: American IV: The Man Comes Around

citation.name: American IV: The Man Comes Around

@graph.description: Johnny Cash's 2002 cover of the song Trent Reznor wrote for Nine Inch Nails, produced by Rick Rubin for American IV: The Man Comes Around: a sparse late recording whose video by Mark Romanek, filmed months before Cash's death, NME named the greatest of all time.
@graph.headline: Johnny Cash - Hurt

citation.name: The Beat Goes On (Jojo Effect, Not With Me)
The Beat Goes On (Sonny & Cher song)
The Beat Goes On (Club des Belugas Remix)

@graph.description: The German lounge project Jojo Effect takes Sonny Bono's 1967 hit for Sonny & Cher into the bar: a five-minute cover from their album Not With Me that went on to fill lounge and electro-swing compilations.
@graph.headline: Jojo Effect - The Beat Goes On

@graph.name: Take It Easy My Brother Charles

citation.name: Take It Easy My Brother Charles (recording)

@graph.description: Jorge Ben's 'Take It Easy My Brother Charles' is a two-and-a-half-minute samba-soul classic from his 1969 album: a swinging guitar, Trio Mocotó's percussion and a warm word of caution to a 'brother of color', half in Portuguese, half in English.
@graph.headline: Jorge Ben Jor - Take It Easy My Brother Charles

@graph.description: Joris Delacroix closes his 2018 album Night Visions with Epoque, seven minutes of melodic deep house in which soft, piano-trained melodies ride a steady, driving pulse.
@graph.headline: Joris Delacroix - Epoque

citation.name: Interview Joris Delacroix : Je pense changer de format sur les sorties
Joris Delacroix, nouvel album Night Visions disponible

@graph.description: The one track on Joris Delacroix's 2018 album Night Visions made with Synapson and sung by Schérazade: the collaboration he says they were supposed to make together, from a record fed by the nights he plays.
@graph.headline: Joris Delacroix, Synapson, Schérazade - I Wanna

@graph.description: A teenage Joss Stone leans into a lilting, reggae-kissed soul groove and sings about wanting less with the husky authority of a singer twice her age.
@graph.headline: Joss Stone - Less Is More

@graph.description: A laid-back fusion of dub, reggae and deep electronic beats from East Germany: JPattersson's 2016 Elevator, the opening track of the EP Rühn, which also carries its own dub version and two remixes.
@graph.headline: JPattersson - Elevator

citation.name: Junior - I Don't Listen Much (Mercury Remix)

@graph.description: The first single from Self Fulfilling Prophets, the 2014 debut of the Berlin-Missouri duo Junior: laconic vocals over a bubbling bass and simple, hypnotic synths, a driving electro-pop song with cynical words.
@graph.headline: Junior - I Don't Listen Much

citation.name: Justice vs. Simian - We Are Your Friends
Justice vs. Simian / Justice vs. Gambit / Espion - Never Be Alone / Steamulation

@graph.description: Justice's remix of Simian's 'Never Be Alone', first pressed on Ed Banger's second release in 2003 and reissued as 'We Are Your Friends' in 2006: a UK top 20 hit whose video won Best Video at the MTV Europe Music Awards.
@graph.headline: Justice Vs Simian - We Are Your Friends

@graph.name: Blood In The Cut - Aire Atlantica Remix

citation.name: K.Flay - Blood In The Cut Remixed
Blood in the Cut (Aire Atlantica remix) (recording)
K.Flay - Blood In The Cut (Aire Atlantica Remix/Audio)

@graph.description: Aire Atlantica's remix of Blood in the Cut, the breakup anthem that earned K.Flay a Grammy nomination for Best Rock Song, collected on the Night Street and Interscope remix release of 2017: an alternative rock song moved into electronic dance-pop.
@graph.headline: K.Flay, Aire Atlantica - Blood In The Cut - Aire Atlantica Remix

citation.name: K.Flay drops new single "High Enough" today

@graph.description: K.Flay's breakthrough answers a decade of songs about getting high with a question, what if I'm already high enough: breezy rhythm, bubbly guitar lines and a sing-song flow produced by Mike Elizondo.
@graph.headline: K.Flay - High Enough

citation.name: Your Girl (Provided to YouTube by Bergen Mafia)

@graph.description: The second track and second single of Hest, the 2011 album Erlend Øye produced for the Bergen band Kakkmaddafakka: light, cheerful indie pop sung by Jonas Nielsen.
@graph.headline: Kakkmaddafakka - Your Girl

@graph.description: Ten and a half minutes from Independent Dancer, the Zurich producer Kalabrese's 2013 album on his own Rumpelmusig: a calm, low-slung jazz house blues with the Berlin singer Khan as guest and a groove bassline from his band, played by Nicolas Jaar years before the album and later rebuilt by Matthew Herbert.
@graph.headline: Kalabrese, Khan - Desperate Man feat. Khan

@graph.name: Fresh and Foolish feat. Sarah Palin

@graph.description: Track four of Independent Dancer, the 2013 album Kalabrese released on his Zurich label Rumpelmusig: a duet between Sacha Winkler and Sarah Palin, a singer from Zurich and not the American politician, which BlackPlastic called beautiful.
@graph.headline: Kalabrese, Sarah Palin - Fresh and Foolish feat. Sarah Palin

citation.name: Kalabrese feat. Sarah Palin - Kafi Lied
Jimi Jules / Kalabrese - Hello Asshole / Kafi Lied (Rumpelmusig, RUMP 003-1)
30 Jahre Compost: Interview mit Michael Reinboth

@graph.description: The B-side of Rumpelmusig's 2014 twelve-inch Hello Asshole / Kafi Lied: Kalabrese's ode to the morning coffee, sung with the Zurich singer Sarah Palin, a choir from his Rumpelorchester and, in the label's words, his characteristic analogue synth pads.
@graph.headline: Kalabrese, Sarah Palin - Kafi Lied

@graph.description: The eighth track of Independent Dancer, the 2013 album of the Zurich producer Kalabrese on his label Rumpelmusig: an airy ballad over a light bossa nova rhythm, with cello by Dominik Löhrer and an uneasy piano under a song about the stresses of ambition.
@graph.headline: Kalabrese - Stone on Your Back

citation.name: KANT teams up for 'Close to the Wire' [Premiere]
Close To The Wire (extended club remix)

@graph.description: The Copenhagen production team KANT stretch Leo Stannard's aching vocal across a seven-minute club arrangement on Black Butter Records, melancholy piano chords and a steady deep house pulse turning heartbreak into something you can dance through.
@graph.headline: KANT, Leo Stannard - Close to the Wire (Club Remix)

citation.name: KATALYST (feat. Stephanie Mckay): Day Into Night – Single - 2011
News: Katalyst ready to drop his third album 'Deep Impressions'
KATALYST "DAY INTO NIGHT" feat. STEPHANIE MCKAY

@graph.description: The Sydney producer Katalyst opens his third album, Deep Impressions, with reggae soul: tremolo guitar and a driving bass under the floating melodies of his long-time collaborator, the American soul singer Stephanie McKay.
@graph.headline: Katalyst, Stephanie McKay - Day into Night

citation.name: Get What You Came For (feat. BullySongs)
Kav Verhouzer feat. BullySongs - Get What You Came For (Official Music Video)

@graph.description: Sunny deep-house chords and a warm, raspy BullySongs vocal: Get What You Came For is an easygoing dancefloor invitation that never pushes, only pulls you in.
@graph.headline: Kav Verhouzer, BullySongs - Get What You Came For

@graph.description: The title track of Kazy Lambist's 2015 debut EP: a smooth, sunlit electronic pop song by the Montpellier producer Arthur Dubreucq, laid-back beats and a playful melody built for summer.
@graph.headline: Kazy Lambist - Doing Yoga

@graph.description: Kele Okereke opens his after-hours record Trick in a whisper: a cool, late-night house groove about the electricity of meeting someone new, sung with Yasmin.
@graph.headline: Kele - First Impressions

citation.name: A Brief History of Kelis, Musical Omnivore

@graph.description: A Neptunes production from Kelis's third album Tasty, written by Pharrell Williams and Chad Hugo: bruised soul in which a lover's woes and a citizen's social concerns share one lyric.
@graph.headline: Kelis - Rolling Through The Hood

@graph.description: A deep cut from Kelis's 2003 album Tasty, written with and produced by the Harlem producer Dame Grease: a love story dressed up as a stick-up.
@graph.headline: Kelis - Stick Up

@graph.description: Sugar Honey Iced Tea, a Neptunes production from Kelis's 2003 album Tasty, is a laid-back R&B love song whose title spells out a well-known euphemism, sung by Kelis in a relaxed, playful tone.
@graph.headline: Kelis - Sugar Honey Iced Tea

citation.name: Kelis' Debut Album 'Kaleidoscope' Turns 20: Anniversary Retrospective
Still Out There: 20 Years Of Kelis' Debut Album 'Kaleidoscope'

@graph.description: A swaggering Neptunes groove from Kelis's debut Kaleidoscope: funk bass wobbles, a husky, desire-flushed vocal and a guest part from a young Pusha T, then still called Terrar.
@graph.headline: Kelis, Terrar - Good Stuff

citation.name: Kellerkind - Ten Years Disco On The Dancefloor

@graph.description: The deep house single that the Swiss producer Marco Biagini, alias Kellerkind, released on Sirion Records in 2012 and put on his album Basement Story, with a birthday-party video shot in the Bern club KAPITEL Bollwerk.
@graph.headline: Kellerkind - Disco On the Dancefloor

citation.name: Free (Original Mix) by KILIAN&FINN feat. NewShoes
Get ready to Shake to KILIAN&FINN's Human Movement remix

@graph.description: The original mix of Free, the 2014 single by the German duo Kilian & Finn featuring the singer NewShoes, released on Exposure Music, the label the duo ran, alongside a radio mix and two remixes by LCAW.
@graph.headline: Kilian & Finn - Free - Original Mix

@graph.description: A warm deep house song from Klangkarussell's 2014 debut album Netzwerk, sung by Will Heard, the English voice of the Austrian duo's UK hit Sonnentanz (Sun Don't Shine).
@graph.headline: Klangkarussell - Moments

@graph.description: 'We Want Your Soul' is Klangkarussell's remix of Adam Freeland's 2003 anti-consumerist breakbeat single: the speech-synthesizer verses and Bill Hicks sample of the original, slowed into a long, hypnotic house groove on the album Netzwerk.
@graph.headline: Klangkarussell - We Want Your Soul

@graph.description: One of two songs on KlangKuenstler's 2014 debut album That's Me sung by the Cape Town-born singer Alice Phoebe Lou, who wrote it with him; a longer earlier recording appears on the album's German edition, Das bin ich.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Amsterdam

@graph.name: Man On the Moon (Miguel Campbell Remix)

citation.name: KlangKuenstler feat. Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On The Moon
Man on the Moon (Miguel Campbell remix)

@graph.description: The British producer Miguel Campbell turns KlangKuenstler and Alice Phoebe Lou's 2014 moon song into a warm, rolling groove for Sunday Best, her voice floating weightless over a bassline that never stops gently pushing forward.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On the Moon (Miguel Campbell Remix)

citation.name: REVIEW: Klangkuenstler - Man On The Moon incl Miguel Campbell mix on Play Elegent / Sunday Best

@graph.description: KlangKuenstler wraps Alice Phoebe Lou's soft, folk-tinged voice in a warm, unhurried deep house shuffle that feels like a slow drive home under a full moon.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On the Moon

citation.name: Track of the Day: KlangKuenstler - Golden

@graph.description: A late-night techno roller from Klangkuenstler's 2015 debut on Great Stuff: a massive, rounded bassline, a nasty but beautiful sawtooth lead and a bed of vinyl noise that makes the dark groove feel strangely warm.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler - Golden

@graph.description: A six-minute house workout from Klangkuenstler's early, groove-first years, built for the long middle stretch of a club night when the floor just wants to jack.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler - Jam Master Jack (Original Mix)

@graph.description: A rolling tech-house groove with classic house warmth underneath: Soul Digger finds the soul in the machine and keeps the floor moving for almost seven minutes.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler - Soul Digger (Original Mix)

@graph.description: The Saarland producer Melokind stretches KlangTherapeuten's Perlentaucher, the pearl diver, to seven and a half minutes at 125 BPM on the duo's 2013 Lochmann Records EP, beside remixes by Robin Schulz and Matthias Kick.
@graph.headline: KlangTherapeuten, Melokind - Perlentaucher - Melokind Remix

@graph.description: Klyne's second single is a compact slice of electronic pop, staccato synth lines under Nick Klein's soulful voice, about chasing a lifelong desire past the fear that fate has already decided.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Closer

citation.name: Bask In The Mellow Summer Pop Of Dutch Duo Klyne

@graph.description: A hushed, late-summer slow jam from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a feather-light falsetto floats over soft keys, tropical-leaning drums and pulsing synths.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Entropy

citation.name: Netherlands-based duo Klyne air visuals for "Paralyzed"

@graph.description: A hushed, slow-burning slice of electronic soul from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a fragile falsetto floats over muted beats and a heart too stunned to move.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Paralyzed

citation.name: Netherlands-based duo Klyne air visuals for Paralyzed

@graph.description: A slow, stripped-down slice of dark electronic R&B from the Dutch duo Klyne, where Nick Klein's soft, close-miked voice drifts over sparse beats and muted synths; the new song on their 2015 Closer EP.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Waiting

@graph.description: 'Knopfauge' is a track from Unknown (Kompakt, 2012), the debut album of Saschienne, the duo of Berlin DJ Sascha Funke and French singer and synth player Julienne Dessagne: minimal electronic music built on Moog lines and patient layering.
@graph.headline: Saschienne - Knopfauge

citation.name: Kollektiv Turmstrasse - Musik Gewinnt Freunde Collection

@graph.description: A seven-minute version of Grillen im Garten, a club track by Kollektiv Turmstrasse, the seventh of eleven tracks on Musik Gewinnt Freunde Collection, a 2013 digital compilation of the Hamburg duo's tracks released by the label Musik Gewinnt Freunde.
@graph.headline: Kollektiv Turmstrasse - Grillen im Garten - Gerberei Version

citation.name: On the Streets (Kollektiv Turmstrasse's Let Freedom Ring remix)
Federleicht - On the Street: The Remixes

@graph.description: Hamburg duo Kollektiv Turmstrasse's 2009 'Let Freedom' remix of Federleicht's On the Streets: melancholic, melodic house of deep beats and slowly unfolding synths, from the label that later released their album.
@graph.headline: Kollektiv Turmstrasse - On The Streets (Let Freedom)

@graph.description: Kölsch's melodic techno meets the warm, weathered voice of WhoMadeWho's Tomas Høffding in Bloodline, a slow-burning track from 1983, an album about childhood road trips across Europe, that swells like a sunrise over the booth.
@graph.headline: Kölsch - Bloodline (feat. Tomas Høffding)

citation.name: Kölsch's new album reflects a "difficult time" in his life
Grey (1989, provided to YouTube by Lucille AB)

@graph.description: The brass-infused Grey, first a Kompakt Speicher 12-inch and then one of the tracks named for grey on Kölsch's 2017 album 1989, a record about grey teenage years built on melodies that break through like sun through cloud.
@graph.headline: Kölsch - Grey

citation.name: From Neo-Trance To Melodic Techno: 6 Tracks You Need To Hear By Konstantin Sibold
Madeleine (Boiler Room: Dixon b2b Âme in Amsterdam, Oct 25, 2012)
Madeleine (Extended Mix), Armada Electronic Elements presents Timeless

@graph.description: Stuttgart DJ Konstantin Sibold's nine-minute house track opened Innervisions' Secret Weapons Part 5 in 2013, was a DJ weapon before it was a record, and came back as a radio edit almost ten years later.
@graph.headline: Konstantin Sibold - Madeleine

@graph.description: Deep, dark bass, insistent drums and Sian Evans' voice cutting through the fog: Addict opens Kosheen's Independence with the pull of something you cannot quit.
@graph.headline: Kosheen - Addict

citation.name: Koudlam - See you All (excerpt from Desniansky Raion by Cyprien Gaillard)

@graph.description: Koudlam's See You All was first heard in Cyprien Gaillard's film performance Desniansky Raion and then anchored Goodbye, his 2009 album on Pan European Recording, a record its label called epic and a critic called symphonic, which French cinema kept borrowing.
@graph.headline: Koudlam - See You All

citation.name: Kruder & Dorfmeister: Neues Album frisch aus den 90er Jahren

@graph.description: Kruder & Dorfmeister's Johnson, a 1995 track found again on old DAT tapes and released in 2020, loops a filtered, slowed line from Robert Johnson's Sweet Home Chicago into slow Viennese downtempo.
@graph.headline: Kruder & Dorfmeister - Johnson

@graph.description: The opening track of Layers, the 2016 debut album of the French producer Kungs, written with and sung by Luke Pritchard of The Kooks, the band Kungs grew up hearing with his father.
@graph.headline: Kungs, Luke Pritchard - Melody

citation.name: 'Intergalactic Lovers', An Ethereal Original Song by Kutiman Featuring Musicians From Dozens of Countries
Weekly Download: Kutiman, Inner Galactic Lovers

@graph.description: 'Inner Galactic Lovers' is Kutiman's 2015 song assembled from parts recorded by 24 freelance musicians in a dozen countries: an ethereal, funky collage in which every player was hired online and never met the others.
@graph.headline: Kutiman - Inner Galactic Lovers

@graph.description: Soft-focus tropical house from Kygo, with plucked melodies and a warm, pleading vocal from Maty Noyes asking someone not to leave just yet.
@graph.headline: Kygo, Maty Noyes - Stay

citation.name: The Hanging Tree (The Hunger Games song)

@graph.description: Three friends from Saint-Denis sing the Hunger Games murder ballad with a string section and a backing choir: the cover that opens L.E.J's 2015 album En attendant l'album, first sung at the Paris premiere of Mockingjay Part 2.
@graph.headline: L.E.J - Hanging Tree

@graph.description: A three-minute haze of blurred synths, soft beats and a distant, weightless voice, Navy Light feels like city lights seen through rain on a night bus window.
@graph.headline: Labyrinth Ear - Navy Light

citation.name: Ladytron: Adorable mix of pop and pretension
100 Greatest Songs of the 00's #85 Ladytron – Seventeen

@graph.description: Ladytron's 2002 single: whirring synthesizers, two cool, interlocking voices and a minimal lyric that takes a swipe at an industry obsessed with youth, shiny and throwaway on the surface and dark underneath.
@graph.headline: Ladytron - Seventeen

inAlbum.name: Kumharas Ibiza Vol.2 (Compiled By DJ Malte M.V.T.)

citation.name: Album of the Week: Music For Dreams 'Best Of' 2
Beautiful Day (Banzai Republic vs. Trentemoller Mix)

@graph.description: The Banzai Republic vs. Trentemøller remix of the Danish duo Laid Back's Beautiful Day, in the 6:58 cut from the Ibiza compilation Kumharas Vol. 2: beachy beats for sunset sets.
@graph.headline: Laidback - Beautiful Day

@graph.description: The song that names Matthieu Chedid's Franco-Malian collective: Toumani Diabaté's cascading kora, the voices of Amadou & Mariam and Jain, and a pun on 'the soul in Mali', from the 2017 album Lamomali.
@graph.headline: Lamomali, -M-, Toumani Diabaté, Amadou & Mariam - L'Âme Au Mali

citation.name: Lana Del Rey – West Coast (Solomun Remix) [Preview]
The Best Remixes of Lana Del Rey's West Coast - MK, Solomun and more

@graph.description: Solomun's eight-minute remix of Lana Del Rey's West Coast sets her sultry, unhurried vocal over a deep, thrumming house groove and a dark, shifting bass, one of the 2014 remixes Del Rey commissioned for the Ultraviolence single.
@graph.headline: Lana Del Rey, Solomun - West Coast - Solomun Remix

@graph.description: The title track of Grounding, the 2006 album the Viennese video artist Michael Langoth released as Langoth on Sunshine Enterprises: a house and downtempo groove in what its label calls the typical Viennese style, with words by the rapper Da Fonz.
@graph.headline: Langoth, Da Fonz - Grounding

citation.name: Las Aves: Die in Shanghai video premiere
Parisian pop-trio Las Aves really want you to get a dog

@graph.description: The Toulouse rock band The Dodoz reborn as Las Aves: a glossy electro-pop single from Die in Shanghai (2016), produced by Dan Levy of The Dø, with a London video about girls doing their own thing.
@graph.headline: Las Aves - N.E.M.

@graph.description: Lekota's I Used To combines nostalgic melodies with a modern electronic sound, creating an emotive and introspective listening experience.
@graph.headline: Lekota - I Used To

@graph.description: Oslo duo Lemaitre pair a sprightly piano line and a brash horn hook with Swedish singer Jennie A.'s floaty voice: an airy electro-pop single that found a second life in a Google Pixel launch film and the first episode of Skam.
@graph.headline: Lemaitre, Jennie A. - Closer

citation.name: Interview with Leska: "Our sound results from a permanent interaction between us"

@graph.description: French producers Les Gordon and Douchka, together as Leska, made L&H the track on their debut EP Circles that the band itself calls haunted by Motown's ghosts: three minutes of electronic pop with an old soul's memory.
@graph.headline: Leska - L&H

byArtist.name: Lilly Wood and The Prick, Robin Schulz

@graph.name: Prayer in C (Robin Schulz Radio Edit)

citation.name: Prayer in C (Robin Schulz radio edit) (recording)

@graph.description: Robin Schulz lifts a mournful 2010 French folk-pop song onto a bouncing deep house beat, Nili Hadida's bleak prayer and a looping guitar riff becoming a number one across Europe in 2014.
@graph.headline: Lilly Wood and The Prick, Robin Schulz - Prayer in C (Robin Schulz Radio Edit)

citation.name: Change (Provided to YouTube by Believe SAS)

@graph.description: The Geneva duo Lipka's 2015 single, later the second track of their album Grande Giocatore: a three-minute song from two childhood friends who fused punk, folk, dancehall and electronica, heard here in its label video, on a balcony and in a remix.
@graph.headline: Lipka - Change

@graph.description: A Geneva duo stops the party to break the worst possible news: a wry, shout-along electro-indie track in which the DJ is told to cut the music because the beer is running out.
@graph.headline: Lipka - No More Beer

@graph.description: A 2013 deep house single by the Los Angeles producer Lonely Boy, the second release of the young US label Dance:Revolt: five minutes of club music issued alongside five remixes and picked up within months by a Hed Kandi compilation.
@graph.headline: Lonely Boy - Love Wanted

citation.name: Louie Austen - One Night In Rio (with lyrics)
Louie Austen: Ein 80er auf den Spuren des Rat Pack

@graph.description: 'One Night In Rio' by Louie Austen is a tongue-in-cheek electro-lounge story from 2001: a Viennese hotel-bar crooner, then in his fifties, counting off a tour from Rio to LA to Moscow and complaining about a taxi, with backing singers echoing every line.
@graph.headline: Louie Austen - One Night In Rio

citation.name: Louisahhh Drops Brutal, Live-Sounding, Post-Alternative Industrial Pop EP
Premiere: Louisahhh presents 'A Trap I've Built', her most visceral work to date
Louisahhh unleashes fervent, punk rock bliss on new track 'Trap', ahead of upcoming EP
Louisahhh: DJ Mag UK cover feature

@graph.description: A dark and pulsating techno track that closes Louisahhh's intentionally brutal 2017 EP A Trap I've Built, delving into desire, control and liberation.
@graph.headline: Louisahhh - Like A Vice

citation.name: Louisahhh channels love and loss on new album The Practice of Freedom

@graph.description: Vitalic reworks the opening track of Louisahhh's techno-punk debut The Practice of Freedom into a five-and-a-half-minute industrial club track, released on the album's 2021 deluxe edition by HE.SHE.THEY.
@graph.headline: Louisahhh - Love Is a Punk (Vitalic Remix)

@graph.description: 'FCKRZ' is a 2021 single by the Viennese singer Luca Malina, R&B-inspired pop about the darker side of relationships, produced by Luca Pivetz with guitar by Lukas Koffler and a self-made video.
@graph.headline: Luca Malina - FCKRZ

citation.name: Clip "Cooler Than Me" : Lucky Luke cartonne avec sa reprise de Mike Posner

@graph.description: The Lithuanian producer Lucky Luke's 2019 deep house reworking of Mike Posner's 2010 debut hit, released on Columbia/B1: a song about feeling snubbed, turned into a laid-back club anthem that became a radio hit in France a year later.
@graph.headline: Lucky Luke - Cooler Than Me

@graph.description: The Brazilian singer and guitarist Luiz Henrique recorded Jorge Ben's Mas Que Nada in New York in 1967 for his Verve album Barra Limpa, with accordion, bass and drums around his voice and guitar.
@graph.headline: Luiz Henrique - Mas Que Nada

citation.name: Lulu Rouge: Bless You [Music For Dreams]

@graph.description: Danish duo Lulu Rouge and their old ally Trentemøller in seven and a half minutes of nocturnal minimal house: reverberating dub bass, slow-building layers and a Basic Channel shadow.
@graph.headline: Lulu's Theme (feat. Trentemøller)

@graph.description: From Lulu Rouge's 2008 debut Bless You, a slow, dub-shadowed Copenhagen downtempo track in which Alice Carreri sings Mikael Simpson's words over deep bass and spacious, echoing textures.
@graph.headline: Sweeter Than Sweet (feat. Alice Carreri)

citation.name: M.A.N.D.Y. vs Booka Shade - Body Language (Original Remaster)
You Don't Know Me (Jax Jones song)
M.A.N.D.Y. Vs. Booka Shade - Body Language

@graph.description: The 2005 Get Physical anthem by M.A.N.D.Y. and Booka Shade, remastered in 2023 for the label's 21st year: chunky drums, warm bass and a melodic hook that climbs up and down the scale and has not stopped uniting dance floors since.
@graph.headline: M.A.N.D.Y., Booka Shade - Body Language - Original Remaster

@graph.description: The closing track of Mafia Klvb's 2022 debut, made with Pilocka Krach and Mommo G: underground lifestyle rap that turns the credit card into a symbol of excess and the persona into the point.
@graph.headline: Mafia Klvb - Credit Card

@graph.description: Solomun's remix of Corporate Butcher, the song Tiefschwarz made with the singer Mama for their Watergate 09 mix CD: released on a Watergate Records EP in November 2011 and later chosen for Solomun's own Selected Remixes 2009–2015.
@graph.headline: MAMA, Tiefschwarz, Solomun - Corporate Butcher - Solomun Remix

@graph.description: Mando Diao trade garage-rock grit for a disco-rock floor-filler, a pulsing four-on-the-floor beat and a shout-along chorus about needing someone to dance with.
@graph.headline: Mando Diao - Dance With Somebody (Radio Version)

citation.name: Review: Marbert Rocel – Catch a Bird

@graph.description: A soulful downtempo song from the German trio Marbert Rocel's second album Catch A Bird: Antje Seifarth's gentle voice over soft, slowly unfolding electronics, made for winding down.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - Hush Now

citation.name: Review: Marbert Rocel – Catch a Bird

@graph.description: Like Abby Said is the eleventh track of Marbert Rocel's Catch A Bird, a Leipzig trio's song of programmed beats, bass, synthesizer and saxophone around Antje Seifarth's voice, made in major with chords in minor.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - Like Abby Said

citation.name: Marbert Rocel - Me, Myself And I

@graph.description: The eleventh track of In the Beginning, the fourth album by the Leipzig trio Marbert Rocel, released on Compost Records in 2015, an album its label describes as delicate synth pads and percussion around Antje Seifarth's guiding voice.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - Me, Myself and I

citation.name: Review: Marbert Rocel – Catch a Bird

@graph.description: The shortest track on Catch A Bird, the 2009 Compost Records album by the Thuringian trio Marbert Rocel: three minutes of Antje Seifarth's voice over bass, acoustic guitar, saxophone and programmed beats, by a band that says it makes music in major with chords in minor.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - My Bed

@graph.description: The fourth and, at 6:23, the longest track of Small Hours, Marbert Rocel's 2012 album on Compost Records: a record the Leipzig band describes as ballads at 130 bpm, moving from early evening to early morning.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - Song For You

@graph.description: Track ten of Catch A Bird, the 2009 Compost Records album by the Thuringian trio Marbert Rocel: four minutes credited to Marcel Aue's programming and Panthera Krause's saxophone, by a band that says it makes music in major with chords in minor.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - Trenchcoat

citation.name: Marc Houle & Miss Kittin - Where is Kittin?
Marc Houle & Miss Kittin - Where is Kittin? (Where is Kittin? EP) Items & Things 2013

@graph.description: The title track of a 2013 Items & Things EP that paired the label's co-founder Marc Houle with Miss Kittin: what the label called a jagged hybrid of Houle's signature style and Kittin's deadpan vocal talent.
@graph.headline: Marc Houle, Miss Kittin - Where is Kittin?

citation.name: Into the Dark (recording and its releases)

@graph.description: The peppy opening track of Top Secret, the 2001 Blue Note album on which the Belgian keyboardist Marc Moulin, a veteran of jazz-rock and of Telex, set cool-jazz vibraphone, organ and a soul vocal over electronic bass and a brushed hi-hat.
@graph.headline: Marc Moulin - Into the Dark

@graph.description: An eighteen-minute minimal track by the Romanian producer Marcu Rareș, the title piece of his 2018 EP for the Romanian minimal techno label Welter Records.
@graph.headline: Marcu Rares - Camimosa

citation.name: Chet Faker And Marcus Marr Share Birthday Card

@graph.description: Nearly eight minutes of sleek, disco-tinged house: Marcus Marr's springy production and bright synths carry Nick Murphy's smoky voice towards a long dancefloor release, the opener of their 2015 EP Work.
@graph.headline: Marcus Marr, Nick Murphy - Birthday Card

@graph.description: Marcus Marr and Chet Faker (Nick Murphy) recorded this disco-funk jam in four days in a Brixton studio in July 2015: a funk-flecked guitar riff and a soulful plea about a relationship going wrong, made into a reason to dance.
@graph.headline: Marcus Marr, Nick Murphy - The Trouble With Us

@graph.description: Marcus Worgull turns The Cure's Lovesong into a slow-building deep house cover sung by Fink, a Dixon set-closer that circulated for a year before Innervisions released it in 2018.
@graph.headline: Marcus Worgull - Love Song

@graph.description: Nine minutes of melodic German minimal from the Jena label Freude am Tanzen: Marek Hemmann's Gemini drives on a swinging house groove while synth patterns and funky tenor-sax licks twist around each other.
@graph.headline: Marek Hemmann - Gemini

@graph.description: Track seven of Bittersweet, Marek Hemmann's second solo album on the Jena label Freude am Tanzen (2013): five and a half minutes of polished house and techno whose sinuous melodies, one critic wrote, not even the most morose human being could resist.
@graph.headline: Marek Hemmann - Hooray

citation.name: Marian debuts on Freude am Tanzen

@graph.description: The opening song of Marian's debut album: a sub bass rising from the depths, cello around Fabian Reichelt's voice and Marek Hemmann's mid-tempo house, a love song that dissolves into a bittersweet groove.
@graph.headline: Marian - For You

citation.name: Mario Basanov - We Are Child Of Love (Official)
Mario Basanov - We Are Child Of Love
We Are Child of Love (Mario's Redub)
Mario Basanov - We are Child Of Love (Cut Version)

@graph.description: The 2012 Needwant single of the Lithuanian producer Mario Basanov, later known as Ten Walls: a slow-motion house original with a smooth, sultry vocal by Minalga, the follow-up to his Lonely Days.
@graph.headline: Mario Basanov - We Are Child Of Love

@graph.description: Kaskade's mix of Dream Machine, the tender song Mark Farina made with Sean Hayes for his 2003 Om Records album Air Farina, released a month later as the closing track of the To Do single: two Chicago-born DJs of San Francisco's house scene on one record.
@graph.headline: Mark Farina, Kaskade - Dream Machine - Kaskade Mix

@graph.name: Girls Like You (feat. Cardi B) - Cardi B Version

citation.name: Hear St. Vincent's Cutting Remix of Maroon 5, Cardi B's 'Girls Like You'
Maroon 5, Girls Like You (Remix) feat. Cardi B, track review
Maroon 5 - Girls Like You ft. Cardi B (Official Music Video)
Girls Like You (Cardi B version), recording

@graph.description: Maroon 5's placid, sentimental pop-rock song from Red Pill Blues, reissued in 2018 with a verse by Cardi B: the version that spent seven weeks at number one and came with a video full of famous women.
@graph.headline: Maroon 5, Cardi B - Girls Like You (feat. Cardi B) - Cardi B Version

@graph.description: A seven-minute deep house homage from the Halle producer Martin Waslewski to his grandfather: driving percussion, piano chords, shakers and a guitar riff, a long build-up and a drop after a long break.
@graph.headline: Martin Waslewski - Gerd

citation.name: Art Department Presents Martina Topley-Bird - Crystalised
Martina Topley-Bird, Mark Lanegan and friends cover The xx's 'Crystalised'
Martina Topley-Bird (Feat. Mark Lanegan & Warpaint) – Crystalised (The xx Cover) Video
Art Department Presents Martina Topley-Bird featuring Mark Lanegan - Crystalised
Martina Topley Bird - Crystalised ft. Mark Lanegan, Warpaint

@graph.description: The original mix of a cover of The xx's debut single, released by Art Department's No.19 label in 2013: Martina Topley-Bird and Mark Lanegan take the two voices over Warpaint's playing, a slow brew of rueful vocals, heavy-limbed bass and chiming percussion, as Resident Advisor heard it.
@graph.headline: Martina Topley-Bird, Mark Lanegan, Warpaint - Crystalised - Original Mix

@graph.description: The December 2017 single that made the Ukrainian singer MARUV and the producer Boosin a hit from Moscow to Warsaw: an English-language dance track whose melody, she said, uses the melodic minor of Slavic romances and chanson rather than the pentatonic scale of American pop.
@graph.headline: MARUV, Boosin - Drunk Groove

citation.name: Massive Attack f. Hope Sandoval of Mazzy Star, Paradise Circus (Gui Boratto Remix) MP3
Gui Boratto - Renaissance: The Mix Collection

@graph.description: Gui Boratto's remix of Massive Attack's Paradise Circus, with Hope Sandoval's voice: a long, tense club reworking that Resident Advisor called Trentemøller-esque and better than the original, here in the 7:41 cut of the Madrid Fashion Week compilation.
@graph.headline: Massive Attack, Gui Boratto - Paradise Circus - Gui Boratto Remix

citation.name: Mat.Joe & David Keno feat. Shamoozey: Early Morning / katermukke 100
Early Morning (Provided to YouTube by Zebralution)
The Love List: Top 20 Tracks July 2015
Interview: Crispy Urban House Originators Mat.Joe

@graph.description: Early Morning is the after-hours house track the Berlin duo Mat.Joe and the producer David Keno made with Shamoozey for Katermukke's hundredth release in 2015: funky, built on a vocal hook, and made, the label says, to keep the memory of a Berlin party night.
@graph.headline: Mat.Joe, David Keno, Shamoozey - Early Morning

@graph.description: French producer Matzak hands the microphone to the hip-hop troupe Forensic on his 2010 album Bring Me the Moon: rolling vocals over a strutting beat and plinking synths, a track Resident Advisor noted for its Skeletor reference.
@graph.headline: Matzak, Forensic - Not safe for work (feat. Forensic)

citation.name: Crosswalk starts 2015 with Max Manie's The Ocean

@graph.description: The Salzburg-born, Vienna-based producer Max Manie's 2016 single for Crosswalk Records in its three-and-a-half-minute radio edit, the only version on the single; six longer remixes for DJs followed later that year.
@graph.headline: Max Manie - Dance - Radio Edit

citation.name: Me & Her, David Keno - Walking Boots (Original Mix) (Bloomingdale 2014)
ME & her & David Keno - Walking Boots (Original Mix) [Suara]

@graph.description: A deep house track that ME & her and the Swiss-born producer David Keno wrote and produced together, first released on Suara's Kitties Go Deep Vol. 2 in February 2014 and heard here as it was licensed to the Austrian compilation Alpine Grooves, Vol. 7 (Kristallhütte).
@graph.headline: ME & her, David Keno - Walking Boots

Melissa Laveaux - Generous Bones - acoustic for In Bed with at Reeperbahn Festival 2013
Mélissa Laveaux - Generous Bones - Session Acoustique Madmoizelle.com

@graph.description: A short song Mélissa Laveaux wrote alone for her 2013 album Dying Is a Wild Night, where the Montreal-born singer of Haitian descent traded folk-pop for rhythm-led arrangements by the trio that produced the record.
@graph.headline: Mélissa Laveaux - Generous Bones

citation.name: Radyo Siwèl: Mélissa Laveaux Gets Back to her Haitian Roots

@graph.description: Mélissa Laveaux turns Kouzen, a traditional Haitian song first recorded in the 1920s, into a two-minute, guitar-driven ride on Radyo Siwèl, her 2018 album about Haiti under the American occupation of 1915 to 1934.
@graph.headline: Mélissa Laveaux - Kouzen

@graph.description: Mélissa Laveaux, a Montreal-born singer-songwriter of Haitian descent, recasts Elliott Smith's bleak 1995 song for percussive finger-style guitar, double bass, claps and drums on her 2008 album Camphor & Copper.
@graph.headline: Mélissa Laveaux - Needle in the Hay

citation.name: Melody Gardot - Same To You - Later... with Jools Holland - BBC

@graph.description: The Dutch producer Bakermat's 2016 remix of Same to You, a song from Melody Gardot's fourth album Currency of Man, released by Decca as a single in July 2016: four minutes that carry a Larry Klein production into house music.
@graph.headline: Melody Gardot, Bakermat - Same To You - Bakermat Remix

@graph.name: I'll Be There For You/You're All I Need To Get By - Puff Daddy Mix

citation.name: I'll Be There for You/You're All I Need to Get By
You're All I Need to Get By
I'll Be There for You / You're All I Need to Get By (Puff Daddy mix)
I'll Be There For You/You're All I Need To Get By (Puff Daddy Mix)

@graph.description: The Puff Daddy Mix of Method Man and Mary J. Blige's 1995 duet sets a Marvin Gaye and Tammi Terrell love song inside a Wu-Tang rap, over a new beat with a repeated Notorious B.I.G. vocal: the radio version of a Grammy-winning single.
@graph.headline: Method Man, Mary J. Blige - I'll Be There For You/You're All I Need To Get By - Puff Daddy Mix

citation.name: Premiere: Soulwax re-writes Metronomy's Love Letters

@graph.description: Soulwax strip Metronomy's sixties-tinged pop down to a gleaming machine groove and rebuild it, six and a half minutes of neon disco-pop driven by the bassline and a slow-burning release.
@graph.headline: Metronomy - Love Letters (Soulwax Remix)

citation.name: Album Review: Metronomy - The English Riviera

@graph.description: The third single from Metronomy's The English Riviera (2011): jolting synths, high-pitched harmonies and Joseph Mount's list of the cities this stretch of Devon coast is not, a summer song that one critic called the album's centrepiece.
@graph.headline: Metronomy - The Bay

citation.name: Gilles Peterson - Broken Folk Funk Latin Soul

@graph.description: The second track of Is You Is, the 2003 album of the Berlin band Micatone on Sonar Kollektiv: a song sung by Lisa Bassenge over real instruments with a little help from machines, also released as a 12-inch single with a Tiefschwarz remix for the clubs.
@graph.headline: Micatone - Plastic Bags & Magazines

inAlbum.name: HIStory - Past, Present and Future, Book I

@graph.description: One of pop's most recognisable bass lines carries Michael Jackson's paranoid tale of a paternity claim, a tight, shadowy groove that sounds as sharp now as it did on Thriller.
@graph.headline: Michael Jackson - Billie Jean

citation.name: I may actually be writing the same song over and over: an interview with Michelle Gurevich

@graph.description: A slow, smoky synth ballad in which Michelle Gurevich's deadpan contralto toasts the giddy first months of a romance while already hearing the ending coming.
@graph.headline: Michelle Gurevich - First Six Months of Love

citation.name: Left You At The Farm (Stefan Baghiu Edit)

@graph.description: Left You At The Farm is a home-recorded ballad from Party Girl, the 2007 debut Michelle Gurevich made as Chinawoman at home in Montreal: a song about a promise to stay until the end, and leaving instead.
@graph.headline: Michelle Gurevich - Left You At The Farm

@graph.description: Michelle Gurevich croons a deadpan, candlelit elegy for love gone cold, with lo-fi synths and a slow-dance sway that make heartbreak feel strangely elegant.
@graph.headline: Michelle Gurevich - Lovers Are Strangers

@graph.description: 'Party Girl' is the home-recorded title song of Michelle Gurevich's 2007 debut, made under the name Chinawoman: a slow, deadpan contralto ballad about nightlife that became her best-known song and gave its title to a Cannes-winning film.
@graph.headline: Party Girl | Michelle Gurevich

citation.name: Mickey Avalon - "Speak of the Devil" review
Rock n roll rapper Mickey Avalon releases Dodging Bullets video featuring Landon McNamara

@graph.description: A darkly comic outlaw ballad from Mickey Avalon's 2020 album Speak of the Devil, produced by Eli Meltzer as Smoov-E: two small-town boys, a shovel and a getaway, over a jangly guitar and a refrain that nothing in this world is free.
@graph.headline: Mickey Avalon, Eli - Ultra-Violence

@graph.description: Miike Snow's 2012 lead single sets sing-along melancholy over glitchy piano chords and a four-on-the-floor house beat, recorded in a Stockholm studio once used by ABBA.
@graph.headline: Miike Snow - Paddling Out

@graph.description: Mirwais, the former Taxi Girl guitarist who would soon produce Madonna's Music, sets a vocoded voice against stop-start acoustic guitar and retro synths: a 2000 French electro single that reached number two on the US club chart.
@graph.headline: Mirwais - Naïve Song

citation.name: First Album (Miss Kittin & The Hacker album)

@graph.description: 'Frank Sinatra' is one of the founding anthems of electroclash: Miss Kittin's deadpan spoken vocal over The Hacker's raw electro, a cool, satirical portrait of fame and excess that still fills dancefloors.
@graph.headline: Miss Kittin - Frank Sinatra

@graph.description: The opener of Moderat's 2009 debut, where Modeselektor and Apparat march a simple machine beat under detuned synths and an anthemic buzzing bass: melancholy that moves, later borrowed by Xavier Dolan's Laurence Anyways.
@graph.headline: Moderat - A New Error

citation.name: An Interview with Headman of Relish Recordings

@graph.description: Headman's own club version of Moisture, his song with the singer Luca Santucci: a sleek, hypnotic nu-disco and house groove stretched for the dance floor, a bonus track on the 2016 deluxe edition of his album ON.
@graph.headline: Headman, Luca Santucci - Moisture (Headman Club Version)

citation.name: Premiere: Monkey Safari talk about the release of their third album on Hommage

@graph.description: An eight-minute track from HI, the 2019 third album of the Halle brothers Monkey Safari on their own label Hommage, which a premiere heard as the feeling of leaving a club at dawn, its brighter side revealed like a sunrise.
@graph.headline: Monkey Safari - New Day

@graph.description: Huacachina, named after a desert oasis in Peru, opened the compilation Kitsuné Parisien 4 in May 2017: electro-pop from MonteRosso, a Paris duo of a singer-violinist and a guitarist-composer whose label hears airy vocals over an underground bass.
@graph.headline: MonteRosso - Huacachina

@graph.description: A smouldering piece of dark synth-pop that opens Mount Sims' 2004 album Wild Light: cold machines and a weary croon circle the remains of something that burned out long ago.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Ashes

@graph.description: One of the dark and intense tracks of the American edition of UltraSex, Mount Sims' 2002 debut on Emperor Norton: old-school electronics combined with modern techno layers, in the words of Exclaim's review.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Black Sunglasses

@graph.description: Deadpan vocals, buzzing analog synths and a drum machine with attitude: Good Service is Mount Sims serving early-2000s electroclash with a sly, suggestive grin.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Good Service

@graph.description: A slow, cold-blooded crawl through synths, live drums and a graveside croon: Grave, from the 2008 album Happily Ever After produced by Thomas Stern, turns Mount Sims' taste for horror into five minutes of nocturnal dread.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Grave

@graph.description: Mount Sims at his most driven: a tight, menacing electro pulse and a vocal set on walking straight into trouble, one of the songs added to Happily Ever After...Again, the 2010 reworking of his darkwave album.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Hellbent

@graph.description: A dark, pulsing piece of electroclash from Mount Sims's 2002 debut UltraSex, released on Gigolo in Europe and Emperor Norton in the US: gritty machine beats, minor-key synth melodies and a cool, defiant vocal.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - How We Do

citation.name: Andy of Jenny (Mount Sims, Jessie Evans), release credits

@graph.description: A short, sharp electroclash track from Mount Sims' 2008 album Happily Ever After, with André Lang's live drums under the synths and the underground punk singer Jessie Evans adding saxophone.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims, Jessie Evans - Andy of Jenny

citation.name: Mt. Sims - Happily Ever After...Again (CD, PUNCH 030)

@graph.description: Mount Sims trades his electroclash gloss for the guitar-driven shadows of his post-punk turn, a short, tense blast of darkwave unease.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - New Authority Volunteers

@graph.description: A night drive with the headlights off: grinding analogue bass, clipped drum machines and Mount Sims's cool, menacing croon from the darker side of electroclash.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - No Yellow Lines

@graph.description: Seven minutes of slow-burning tension, Restless loops a nervous synth figure and a stalking beat until the repetition itself becomes the thrill.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Restless

@graph.description: Cold synth stabs and a deadpan, sneering vocal turn revenge into a dancefloor chant: Mount Sims at his most wiry, sleazy and defiant.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - The Bitten Bite Back

@graph.description: Mount Sims trades the club for a scuffed, shrugging groove, with Toby Dammit of Iggy Pop's and Nick Cave's bands on drums: What's the Big Deal asks its question with a sneer and a beat that will not sit still.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims, Toby Dammit - What's the Big Deal

@graph.description: Cold machine rhythm and a detached croon from the American edition of Mount Sims' 2002 debut UltraSex, an electroclash meditation on being close to someone and still completely on your own.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Together Alone

citation.name: The Greatest UK MCs of All Time: Ms Dynamite

@graph.description: Ms. Dynamite spells out her own name in a singalong hook and raps about where she came from: a Salaam Remi production from the Mercury Prize-winning A Little Deeper that took her to number five in the UK in 2002.
@graph.headline: Ms. Dynamite - Dy-Na-Mi-Tee

@graph.description: The lead single of Muse's 2009 album The Resistance: a glam-rock stomp that critics compared to the Doctor Who theme, a call to rise up against control, and the band's best-selling single.
@graph.headline: Muse - Uprising

citation.name: Mydy Rabycad mají klip Freedom a brzy vydají desku
Klip týdne: S Numbers představují Mydy (Rabycad) svou transformaci a nový směr

@graph.description: Freedom, a two-and-a-half-minute single of May 2019, is the song the Prague electropop band Mydy Rabycad called the dividing line between their career so far and the new era that came with the album Numbers and the shorter name MYDY.
@graph.headline: MYDY - Freedom

citation.name: Various Artists - The Neptunes Present... Clones

@graph.description: N.E.R.D and Clipse close the Neptunes' Clones compilation with a keyboard-driven rap-rock hybrid: a Queen-sized arena chorus against fast-firing hip-hop verses.
@graph.headline: N.E.R.D, Clipse - Loser

citation.name: Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)
A Man and His Music – Part II

@graph.description: Nancy Sinatra's 1966 version of Sonny Bono's song, built on Billy Strange's haunting tremolo guitar, is a hushed ballad of childhood love and betrayal that Quentin Tarantino revived over the opening credits of Kill Bill.
@graph.headline: Nancy Sinatra - Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)

citation.name: The White House just joined Spotify: listen to the President's summer playlist

@graph.description: Nappy Roots turn a sunny, soulful beat and a sing-along hook into a Southern porch-step anthem about waking up, counting blessings and hoping today goes right.
@graph.headline: Nappy Roots - Good Day

citation.name: Track By Track: Nicola Cruz – Prender Al Alma
Review: Nicolá Cruz – Prender el Alma
Nicola Cruz Weaves a Tale of Ecuador's Musical Spirit on 'Prender El Alma'

@graph.description: A slow, dub-tinged cumbia from Prender el Alma, the 2015 debut on which Ecuadorian producer Nicola Cruz set out his Andes Step: plucked, reverberated guitar over a laid-back rhythm section, made, in his words, for forgetting past love affairs.
@graph.headline: Nicola Cruz - Cumbia del Olvido

citation.name: Nicolas Jaar - A Time For Us review

@graph.description: A young Nicolas Jaar's slow, sultry minimal-house classic, a crooned vocal and dusty, swaying textures that famously sink from dance tempo into a long, swooning breakdown nobody wants to mix out of.
@graph.headline: Nicolas Jaar - Time For Us

Nicolas Repac - Swinging in the Rain

@graph.description: Nicolas Repac, Arthur H's guitarist turned sample collagist, builds a modern, repetitive jungle out of old records on the second track of his 2004 debut Swing-Swing, its title a wink at Singin' in the Rain.
@graph.headline: Nicolas Repac - Swinging in the Rain

@graph.headline: The Lost Fingers - Pump up the Jam

@graph.description: Sting wrote 'Roxanne' after seeing street workers near the band's Paris hotel in 1977: a plea to a woman to leave that life, set to off-beat reggae guitar and a tango-like rhythm, the A&M debut single that became the Police's signature song.
@graph.headline: The Police - Roxanne

Youth title track 'You Got The Love' by The Retrosettes

@graph.headline: The Retrosettes Sister Band - You Got The Love

@graph.headline: The Roots, Jill Scott - You Got Me (Featuring Jill Scott) - Live / 1999

@graph.description: A warm slice of French disco-funk from the man behind Starlight, where synths and a rubber-band bassline turn a fleeting moment into a long, glowing groove.
@graph.headline: The Supermen Lovers - Moments

@graph.headline: The Supermen Lovers - Say No More

Digital-savvy musician earns money from silly songs
When kids yell 'Alexa, play poop!' you'll hear these songs
Poop Poop Poop Poop Song, recording

@graph.description: The biggest hit of Matt Farley's toilet-humour band The Toilet Bowl Cleaners: a two-minute song named for the word children shout at smart speakers, and by his estimate streamed millions of times on Amazon Music.
@graph.headline: The Toilet Bowl Cleaners - Poop Poop Poop Poop Song

@graph.description: The Weeknd's Blinding Lights, written and produced with Max Martin and Oscar Holter, is a neon 1980s pastiche of racing drum machines and a chiming synth hook that became the most streamed song in Spotify's history.
@graph.headline: The Weeknd - Blinding Lights

citation.name: Trunk Rock: The White Stripes, Elephant, and the seven note riff that shook the world
The Genius Of… Elephant by The White Stripes
The White Stripes - Black Math (Official Video)

@graph.description: The second track of Elephant: a fast, punk-edged garage-rock blast from The White Stripes, aimed at a high-school maths teacher, carried by Jack White's riff and wail and Meg White's loose, relentless drums.
@graph.headline: The White Stripes - Black Math

citation.name: The White Stripes - Seven Nation Army (Official Music Video)

@graph.description: The White Stripes' 2003 opener of Elephant: a seven-note riff played on a guitar pitched down an octave, Meg White's heartbeat drum and a song with no sung chorus, which became a stadium chant around the world.
@graph.headline: The White Stripes - Seven Nation Army

@graph.description: 'Crystalised', The xx's 2009 debut single, is minimal indie pop at its most intimate: a muted guitar riff, a sparse beat by Jamie xx, and two voices, Romy Madley Croft's and Oliver Sim's, answering each other verse by verse.
@graph.headline: The xx - Crystalised

@graph.description: Plucked strings, a chorus of voices and Rotem Bar Or's raw tenor make this Tel Aviv folk song feel like a lullaby sung in a dark, uneasy time.
@graph.headline: theAngelcy - My Baby Boy

citation.name: THYLACINE - No mic Stand (feat. Camille Després)

@graph.description: The opening track of Intuitive, the first EP by Thylacine, the Angers producer and former saxophonist William Rezé, released in December 2012 with the singer Camille Després on three of its seven tracks.
@graph.headline: Thylacine, Camille Després - No Mic Stand

citation.name: Tiggs Da Author: Run follow-up Georgia live for Gigwise session

@graph.description: Tiggs Da Author's raspy, swaggering vocal rides a vintage soul feel and a hip-hop bounce on the 2015 love song, produced by Show N Prove, that followed his first single Run and became his breakthrough.
@graph.headline: Tiggs Da Author - Georgia

inAlbum.name: Tim Love Lee: Fully Bearded (15 Years of Tummy Touch Records in Dub)

citation.name: News: Tim 'Love' Lee Tummy Touch anniversary album
Fully Bearded: 15 Years Of Tummy Touch Records In Dub
Fully Bearded: 15 Years of Tummy Touch Records in Dub

@graph.description: Tim 'Love' Lee's previously unreleased dub of New Young Pony Club, once signed to his Tummy Touch label as Organic Audio, made in his Brooklyn studio on a modified vintage radio mixing board for the label's fifteenth-anniversary album Fully Bearded in 2011.
@graph.headline: Tim Love Lee - Dub Cherie

citation.name: Multi-Platinum Recording Artists Timmy Trumpet & Gabry Ponte Release 'Mad World' Reimagined via New Single & Video
Timmy Trumpet & Gabry Ponte - Mad World
Timmy Trumpet & Gabry Ponte - Mad World (Official Music Video)

@graph.description: The Australian trumpeter and DJ Timmy Trumpet and Eiffel 65's Gabry Ponte take the Gary Jules piano version of Tears for Fears' Mad World to the festival stage: a pitched-up vocal, a piano drop and trumpet runs, with a video shot in Philadelphia in November 2020.
@graph.headline: Timmy Trumpet, Gabry Ponte - Mad World

citation.name: Timmy Trumpet & Vini Vici join forces on brand new track 'Thunder': Listen
Timmy Trumpet & Vini Vici - Thunder (Official Audio)

@graph.description: The Australian trumpeter-DJ Timmy Trumpet and the Israeli psytrance duo Vini Vici meet again on Thunder, a 2020 Dharma single that WeRaveYou heard as a kick-and-bass track infused with trumpet sounds, under three minutes long.
@graph.headline: Timmy Trumpet, Vini Vici - Thunder

@graph.description: Timo Maas's 'Shifter', featuring MC Chickaboo, is a driving 2002 single from his debut album Loud: German club production at the meeting point of house and breakbeat, with an MC riding the groove; a UK top 40 hit.
@graph.headline: Timo Maas - Shifter

citation.name: Tinush drops a 'Heavy' groove in new single with PVMPS
Je Veux (Provided to YouTube by TuneCore)

@graph.description: Je Veux, French for 'I want', opens the 2019 debut album the Berlin producer Tinush released himself, first listed as the Tinnitush EP and now titled Collection 01: four and a half minutes from a producer who builds on accessible club music and a grounding in jazz.
@graph.headline: Tinush - Je Veux

@graph.description: 'Sandburg', German for sandcastle, is the title track of the Berlin producer Tinush's 2014 EP on Crosswalk: seven minutes of melodic deep house, later cut to a three-minute radio edit, with remixes by Alec Troniq and Umami.
@graph.headline: Tinush - Sandburg

citation.name: Tom Fire - No Food (feat. Linval Thompson)

@graph.description: No Food brings the Jamaican roots singer and producer Linval Thompson to Low Fidelity, the 2015 second album of the Paris producer and beatmaker Tom Fire: reggae from a studio built on keyboards, with a refrain a dub reviewer promised would stay in your head.
@graph.headline: Tom Fire, Linval Thompson - No Food (feat. Linval Thompson)

citation.name: Tom Misch & De La Soul Come 'Through' With An Unexpected Collaboration
Tom Misch & De La Soul Get Groovy For 'It Runs Through Me'
Posdnuos Delivers A Vintage Guest Verse On A Song That's From The Soul (Video)
Review: Have a Party with Tom Misch's Debut 'Geography'
Tom Misch - It Runs Through Me (feat. De La Soul) [Official Video]

@graph.description: A song from Tom Misch's 2018 debut album Geography: a riff-laden tribute to the power of music, with a bossa-tinged guitar groove and a guest verse from De La Soul's Posdnuos.
@graph.headline: Tom Misch, De La Soul - It Runs Through Me

citation.name: Inside Track: Tones And I 'Dance Monkey'
TONES AND I - DANCE MONKEY (OFFICIAL VIDEO)

@graph.description: Tones and I's 2019 song about busking, built by producer Konstantin Kersting from the loop-station arrangement she played on the street, which spent 24 weeks at number one in Australia and became one of the most streamed songs on Spotify.
@graph.headline: Tones And I - Dance Monkey

citation.name: Tones and I – The Kids Are Coming

@graph.description: The title track of Tones And I's 2019 debut EP, written by Toni Watson and produced by Konstantin Kersting: a generational anthem of horns, finger snaps and a spoken-word elder that split critics between rallying cry and empty gesture.
@graph.headline: Tones And I - The Kids Are Coming

@graph.description: Orlando Higginbottom's breakthrough as Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs: lush synths, a dance-floor pulse and Luisa Gerstein's voice, first on a 2010 Greco-Roman EP and then a 2011 Polydor single that soundtracked Nokia's Lumia adverts.
@graph.headline: Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs - Garden

citation.name: Touch And Go - I Find You Very Attractive (CD, Europe, 1999)
Touch & Go - Tango In Harlem (lyrics and writers)
Tango In Harlem (I Find You Very Attractive, provided to YouTube by Universal Music Group)

@graph.description: An album track from Touch & Go's 1999 debut I Find You Very Attractive, written by David Lowe and its vocalist Julia Lara Fischer: a snowbound Harlem anecdote told over the project's retro-lounge jazz, later listed as a 2001 single.
@graph.headline: Touch & Go - Tango In Harlem

@graph.description: Traum:a turns Bobby Hebb's 1960s standard Sunny into deep house for 2014; the extended mix, at 5:26, gives the old melody two more minutes of room than the radio edit.
@graph.headline: Trauma - Sunny - Extended Mix

citation.name: Trentemøller Uses Chris Isaak's Blue Hotel to Tell His Late Night Tale
Take Cover: Trentemøller Vs. Chris Isaak
Blue Hotel (Provided to YouTube by The Orchard Enterprises)

@graph.description: Trentemøller's exclusive cover for his 2011 Late Night Tales mix slows Chris Isaak's 1987 Blue Hotel into a noisy, dusty male-female duet for Marie Fisker and Sort Sol's Steen Jørgensen.
@graph.headline: trentemøller - Blue Hotel

citation.name: Tricky x Young Fathers 'Nicotine Love' (StraightFace Remix)

@graph.description: The track Tricky shared ahead of Adrian Thaws, the 2014 album named after his birth name: a bloopy electro beat, Francesca Belmonte's expansive vocal and his answer to a fan surprised that he liked house music.
@graph.headline: Tricky, Francesca Belmonte - Nicotine Love

@graph.description: You Showed Me is the love story of Trinidad Senolia's 2014 EP Postcards From Strangers: a seventies-inspired dialogue between a heroine and her hero, wound around the Turtles' classic and turned, in the label's words, into a deep soulful groove.
@graph.headline: Trinidad Senolia - You Showed Me - Edit

@graph.description: The queer electropunk duo Tubbe, who moved from Munich to Berlin in 2013, set the small-town dream of the big city against its confetti, noise and 1-euro-shop reality, a 2015 synth-pop single from their Audiolith album Keine Arbeit lieber Tanzen.
@graph.headline: Tubbe - In Berlin

citation.name: Tube & Berger ft. Ghost Loft - Set Free [Kittball]

@graph.description: Tube & Berger's Set Free, with the Los Angeles producer Ghost Loft singing: a 2016 Kittball single that dances between deep house and indie electronica, dark and melancholic, here in its original mix.
@graph.headline: Tube & Berger, Ghost Loft - Set Free - Original Mix

@graph.description: 'Tum Rakak' is a song by Deluxe, the moustachioed band from Aix-en-Provence: a funky live-band groove in B-flat minor with Liliboy singing a gleefully absurd lyric about curiosity, party crumbs and a truck that reeks in the heat.
@graph.headline: Deluxe - Tum Rakak

citation.name: Tweak - Hybrid Organics (Straight Ahead, SAR 022 CD)
Fathorn
citation.publisher: YouTube (TWEAK - Topic, provided by iMusician Digital AG)

@graph.description: Fathorn opens Hybrid Organics, the 2001 album of the Swiss producer Cyril Boehler as Tweak on Zürich's Straight Ahead label: programmed nu-jazz beats with an alphorn played by the jazz trombonist Robert Morgenthaler.
@graph.headline: Tweak - Fathorn

citation.name: Four Tet remixes 'Smalltalk' by Nigel Godrich's Ultraísta project

@graph.description: 'Smalltalk' is the 2012 lead single of Ultraísta, the trio of Radiohead producer Nigel Godrich, drummer Joey Waronker and singer Laura Bettinson: layered synthesizers and afrobeat-minded drums under a plea to stop the small talk, heard here in Four Tet's garage-shuffle remix.
@graph.headline: Ultraísta - Smalltalk

citation.name: Destructive (Provided to YouTube by Universal Music Group)
Urban Species - Destructive (description on the band's channel UrbanSpeciesTV)

@graph.description: Destructive is the second track of Blanket, the 1998 album by the Tottenham hip-hop group Urban Species: a jazzy beat with light guitar that starts small and swells into a wall of sound by its chorus, sung by Elisabeth Troy and Jeffrey Darnell, with strings arranged by Everton Nelson.
@graph.headline: Urban Species - Destructive

citation.name: Album Review: Utah Jazz presents Vintage
Utah Jazz: meet the man who inspired Sun & Bass
Take No More (DJ N-Type Remix) / Enter The Jungle (Instrumental) / Burnt Out

@graph.description: Liquid funk from Utah Jazz's 2010 album Vintage, finished in a few sleepless early-morning hours on headphones: drum and bass that, in its maker's words, fuses prog rock piano samples with a great blues vocal and guitar.
@graph.headline: Utah Jazz - Take No More

@graph.description: A pulsating electro track from Vitalic's 2001 Poney EP on International DeeJay Gigolo: driving machine beats and a snarling synth riff that capture the raw energy of the early-2000s dance floor.
@graph.headline: Vitalic - You Prefer Cocaine

@graph.description: Waldeck sets Zeebee's smoky voice inside a crackling, sepia-toned ballroom swing, a downtempo daydream about a love that only lives on in memory.
@graph.headline: Waldeck - Memories

citation.name: Waldeck - Never Let You Go - feat. Patrizia Ferrara (taken from the album Atlantic Ballroom)

@graph.description: A catchy, francophile song from Atlantic Ballroom, the 2018 album Klaus Waldeck released on Dope Noir as the successor to Ballroom Stories, sung by Patrizia Ferrara, the voice he found through his Italian-flavoured album before it.
@graph.headline: Waldeck, Patrizia Ferrara - Never let you go

@graph.description: 'Midsummer Night Blues' is a song from Viennese producer Waldeck's 2007 album Ballroom Stories, written and sung by Zeebee: late-1920s ballroom swing seen through modern production, with the crackle of shellac and a summer night's melancholy.
@graph.headline: Midsummer Night Blues (feat. Zeebee)

Wamdue Project Feat. Jonathan Mendelsohn - Forgiveness (CD single)

@graph.headline: Wamdue Project, Jonathan Mendelsohn - Forgiveness - Extended Original

@graph.name: King Of My Castle - Roy Malone's King Mix

King of My Castle (Roy Malone's King Mix)
Wamdue Project - King of My Castle (Official HD Video)

@graph.description: Roy Malone's King Mix turned Chris Brann's downtempo King of My Castle, sung by Gaelle Adisson, into the house record that topped the UK singles chart in 1999: a club hit whose title echoes Freud's line that the ego is not master in its own house.
@graph.headline: Wamdue Project, Roy Malone - King Of My Castle - Roy Malone's King Mix

citation.name: Wax Tailor - Tales of Forgotten Melodies
Wax Tailor - Tales of the Forgotten Melodies
Wax Tailor - Hope And Sorrow LP [Decon]
Wax Tailor - Our Dance (Feat. Charlotte Savary)

@graph.description: The breakout single from Wax Tailor's 2005 debut Tales of the Forgotten Melodies: Charlotte Savary of the French band Clover sings among strange samples and cellos in a darkly melancholy piece of French trip-hop.
@graph.headline: Wax Tailor, Charlotte Savary - Our Dance

citation.name: Que Sera, Sera (Whatever Will Be, Will Be)
Wax Tailor - Que Sera - (Phonovisions Symphonic Version)

@graph.description: Wax Tailor's Que Sera, his early track built on Doris Day's song from Hitchcock's The Man Who Knew Too Much, re-orchestrated in 2014 for the concerts with a 35-piece orchestra and a 17-voice choir that marked ten years of his music.
@graph.headline: Wax Tailor - Que Sera - Phonovisions Symphonic Version

citation.name: Weval - The Most - Live from HERE at Outernet in London (Remember Tour 2023)

@graph.description: A track from Half Age, the 2013 debut EP of the Amsterdam duo Weval on Atomnation, a record its own note sums up as chopped-up minimal vocals, analogue sounds and ever-evolving chords; the duo were still playing it live ten years later.
@graph.headline: Weval - The Most

citation.name: A New Wave of Musical Fusion with Whilk and Misky

@graph.description: 'Darklands' is one of the first two songs the London duo Whilk & Misky ever wrote: a slow-burning blend of blues guitar, electronic production and a voice that starts quietly and ends up belting, from their 2014 debut EP The First Sip.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Darklands

citation.name: Whilk and Misky: new wave musical fusion
Whilk & Misky - I Want Your Lovin'

@graph.description: A hushed, smoky vocal floats over plucked folk guitar and a slow electronic pulse, turning a simple declaration of devotion into a late-night confession.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Babe I'm Yours

citation.name: Premiere: Whilk & Misky - Clap Your Hands
Whilk and Misky - Clap Your Hands

@graph.description: The 2014 breakthrough of the London duo Whilk & Misky: a barefoot, bossa-nova-tinged acoustic song with handclaps for percussion, played on Zane Lowe's Radio 1 show and later carried onto dance floors by a Solomun remix.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Clap Your Hands

citation.name: A New Wave of Musical Fusion with Whilk and Misky

@graph.description: Whilk & Misky blend acoustic warmth with electronic pulse on this track from My Round, Charlie Dickens' soulful voice and Nima Khaste's production chasing a simple wish: to get what we want.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Get What We Want

citation.name: Whilk & Misky - I Want Your Lovin'

@graph.description: Whilk & Misky's London soul-pop at its most direct: a warm, swinging groove and a voice that asks for exactly one thing, over and over, until you want it too.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - I Want Your Lovin' (Edit)

@graph.description: WHTKD loops a soulful, pleading vocal over a warm, rolling deep house groove, a track that sounds like late afternoon turning into evening.
@graph.headline: WHTKD - Say to Me

@graph.description: The opening track of Babyblues, the 2012 debut album of the Hamburg-born singer Y'akoto, who grew up partly in West Africa: a song she wrote with Amo Jr., produced by KAHEDI, that OkayAfrica heard as a smooth excursion into golden R&B with a raspy voice and staccato pop choruses.
@graph.headline: Y'akoto - Diamonds

citation.name: Yoko Duo - Behaving Like A Widower

@graph.description: Stimming wraps Yoko Duo's fragile song in velvet: a slow, organic deep house remix full of soft textures, a hushed vocal and the feeling of a room going quiet.
@graph.headline: Yoko Duo, Stimming - Close These Curtains (Stimming Remix)

@graph.name: Dragon Fly feat. Billy Oden (Album Version)

citation.name: Dragon Fly feat. Billy Oden (feat. Billy Oden)

@graph.description: A dream track from Zwicker's 2009 album Songs of Lucid Dreamers on Compost Records: the spoken-word artist Billy Oden's lines about getting lost in a jungle of white crocodiles and millipedes, dedicated to the producer's son Ryu.
@graph.headline: Zwicker - Dragon Fly feat. Billy Oden (Album Version)

@graph.description: Sleepwalking, from Zurich producer Zwicker's 2009 album Songs of Lucid Dreamers on Compost Records: a song about dreaming, written and sung by the Australian Jamie Lloyd, whose voice the label calls blue-eyed soul meets folk.
@graph.headline: Zwicker - Sleepwalking feat. Jamie Lloyd

@graph.description: 'Oddity' is a discofied highlight of Zurich producer Zwicker's 2009 album Songs of Lucid Dreamers on Compost Records: propulsive beats, a funky bass line and xylophone under the voice of guest singer Olivera Stanimirov.
@graph.headline: Zwicker - Oddity (feat. Olivera Stanimirov)
